author: Durk
install_msg: Government installed. Load the Polls cog, then use `[p]government admin setup #channel` to choose the government channel and create the read-only current-laws register. Most commands are prefix commands; party create/edit remain slash commands.
name: Government
short: Parties, presidential elections, terms, and constitutional lawmaking.
description: A persistent server government with political parties, permissionless party and qualifying Party Leader roles, private qualifying-party channels, administrative party management, 24-hour presidential elections, two-week terms, presidential appointments, mandatory law discussion periods, public law and repeal votes, a synchronized read-only current-laws channel, and immutable safety rules.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores Discord user IDs for party membership, party leadership, elected offices, law proposals, and election records. Administrators can remove government records, and Red's data-deletion hooks remove a requesting user's memberships and office references.
